title: Library Digital Checkouts Nearly Caught Physical Visits
hook: Library buildings lost visits while borrowing quietly moved onto phones.
closing: Libraries did not disappear. Their front door moved onto the screen in your hand.
question: How do you use libraries?

segments.say: Library visits reached 800 million, still far below their earlier peak. The buildings never fully recovered.
Library digital checkouts reached 739 million, showing readers moved their borrowing online instead of disappearing.
